scripts.build:docker: bun run build && docker build -t auth-atom .
scripts.test: bun run load-env -- vitest run tests/unit
scripts.db:pull: bun run load-env -- bun drizzle-kit pull
scripts.db:seed: bun run load-env -- psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 $DATABASE_URL -f scripts/seed.sql
scripts.db:push: bun run load-env -- bun drizzle-kit push
scripts.db:generate: bun run load-env -- bun drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate: bun run load-env -- bun drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.db:view: bun run load-env -- bun drizzle-kit studio
